snippet.title: Sketch Quest (Flash Game) Gameplay
snippet.description:
Thanks to Charles Bazile for commenting this request. This old flash game came out in 2011, and it was done by 5 students at a Vancouver Film School Game Design program. It's where a player can guide a paperboy through paper objects, draw their own enemies, required weapons, and take on the 4 levels to beat to complete the entire game.
